_about: The hand-written invariants of tests/invariants and the inferred rule that would say the same. 'categories' are action categories of the engine ('*' = any action, 'base' = any tab, 'base@tab' = that tab). 'implied_by' lists stronger statements that also count. Used by inference/manual_coverage.py.

invariants.name: Data Text View reflects internal data
GUI required stars match schema.required
GUI rows complete, no stale values
invariants.note: 'No stale rows' = gui_row_set; 'every data key has a row' = gui_rows_complete (view=data).

invariants.name: GUI string values match data
GUI validation icons match schema violations
GUI icon matches the Text View additionalProperties error
invariants.reason: Fields are recorded (de_gui icon, de_data, de_schema) but gui_validation_agreement skips rows without a declared schema, which are exactly the additionalProperties rows. Needs an 'undeclared key' variant.

invariants.name: Text View markers match schema violations
invariants.reason: de_text.annotation_errors is recorded (count only). Needs a template that compares the marker count with the number of data-vs-schema violations.

invariants.name: Text View marks the blank key
invariants.reason: Needs the marker count compared with the violation count including the blank key; only the blank-key part differs from INV-D7.

invariants.name: Schema state is an object
invariants.note: Stricter than the hand-written check: INV-S0 also allows a boolean schema.

invariants.name: Schema Text View reflects internal schema
GUI rows exist for all top-level schema keys
invariants.note: Hand-written check skips the $schema key; the template does not.

invariants.name: Schema title field matches internal schema
invariants.note: Says the same for every GUI input of the Schema Editor; the title row is one of them.

invariants.name: Schema GUI validation icons match meta-schema violations
invariants.note: Snapshot is taken at once; the hand-written check waits up to 3 s for the icons.

invariants.name: No uncaught app errors
invariants.note: Counts every console error, not only uncaught exceptions.

invariants.name: GUI is not stuck on a loading spinner
invariants.note: Stronger: also requires a non-blank GUI; the snapshot reads the spinner at capture time, the hand-written check waits 2.5 s.

invariants.name: expand keeps the data
invariants.note: Expand, collapse and mode switch are one category (ui_only) in the engine.

invariants.name: expand keeps the schema
invariants.note: Expand, collapse and mode switch are one category (ui_only) in the engine.

invariants.note: Expand, collapse and mode switch are one category (ui_only) in the engine.

invariants.name: collapse keeps the data
invariants.note: Expand, collapse and mode switch are one category (ui_only) in the engine.

invariants.name: mode switch keeps the data
invariants.note: Expand, collapse and mode switch are one category (ui_only) in the engine.

invariants.name: mode switch keeps the schema
invariants.note: Expand, collapse and mode switch are one category (ui_only) in the engine.

invariants.name: rename keeps the number of data keys
invariants.note: In the Schema Editor the data is unchanged (stability), which implies the same count.

invariants.name: rename keeps the number of schema.properties
invariants.note: In the Data Editor the schema is unchanged (stability), which implies the same count.

invariants.name: rename swaps exactly one schema.properties key
invariants.note: One rename = edit distance 1 anywhere in the schema; implies at most one top-level swap.

invariants.name: rename swaps exactly one data key
invariants.note: One rename = edit distance 1 anywhere in the data; implies at most one top-level swap.

invariants.name: no 'Rename conflict' dialog unless the new name already existed
invariants.reason: rename_conflict_dialogs is recorded; no template relates the dialog's name to the keys of the previous state.

invariants.name: add-item keeps schema.properties keys
add-item-required grows schema.required by one
invariants.note: change_count finds 'exactly k changes'; it does not say the change is a growth.

invariants.name: add-item-required adds the key to the data
The schema state stays an object after any action
